findings.title: The native plan loader refuses EW plans: 'loop v2 plan: a (trace) step above the family rank'
findings.checks: every check of the row: the executor is not formed (both input paths)
findings.evidence: probe-rank (SC07, h h > h h QED): 12 of 87 families are written with rank 2 (schedules.build_trie: the largest summed segment q-degree of a ring) while plan_export._Exporter._step writes rank_in = the largest source storage and degree = the largest edge degree of a trie node (2 + 1 = 3), which rusticol's derive.rs / plan.rs refuse: a node joining rings of degree-0 and degree-1 vertices (W, Z, Goldstone and Higgs rings) over-runs every single ring. Candidate fix, tried in a scratch worktree (tmp/ms-validate/wt-fix, f1): the family's written rank bounds its steps, rank = max(trie.rank, max step rank_in + degree) in plan_export._Exporter.family (forward states and merged closures likewise): VH01 (Python inputs) 134/134 checks pass against MadLoop QP, SC07 (native inputs) every check but its vanishing single pole (ours 1e-33, MadLoop 1e-17; listed since)
findings.status: fixed on work/v2-ms-validate (52eaff60, the candidate of wip/v2-ms-validate-f1-rank: the family's written rank bounds its steps, one expression in plan_export._Exporter.family; no owner was routed and MS-MODEL, whose 4f99d7fe fixed VV02 only, is integrated): every F1 row passes its nightly tier at the branch's fixes (tmp/ms-validate/f4 at 5901ede1 and r5 at baab3247): SC04 134/134, SC06 82/82, SC07 82/82 (its binary64 vanishing single pole against 1e-10 F_s), TV03 254/254, V301 82/82, VH01 134/134, VH02 134/134, VH03 134/134; VV02 261/261 (mp1); a plan the loader admitted before is exported unchanged (a step within the trie rank leaves the family rank)
findings.routed: MS-VALIDATE (fixed in the package; reviewable as its own commit)

findings.title: SC08 (t t~ > w+ w-), ST03 (g b > t w-) and the b b~ members of MP01, MP02, G_mu with MB = ymb = 0 fixed, fail building the scalar evaluator: the untaken branch of a decided '0 if MB == 0 else ...' counterterm parameter keeps an infinite coefficient
findings.checks: every check: native inputs fail in native_trees._parameter_program, Python inputs in scalar_bindings.ScalarBindingPlan (scalar_frontend.evaluator)
findings.evidence: probe-f2 (SC08 on Python inputs, 2026-10-30): 2 of the 36 bound outputs fail alone, the t~ b W+ UV counterterm coupling c_UVtxbWp1EW at eps^-1 and eps^0. Its source holds the UFO's '0 if MB == 0 else <...>/MB...' counterterm parameters; scalar_frontend lowers an IfExp with both branches (symbolica::if(truth(if(equal(0,0),1,0)), 0, <else>)), so with MB fixed to 0 the untaken branch divides by zero (Symbolica: 'Created infinity by raising 0 to the power of -1') and the evaluator refuses the infinite coefficient. Rows without this coupling only log the warning. Candidate fix (owner's call): decide an IfExp whose lowered condition is a constant before lowering its branches (lower only the taken branch), in the scalar frontend that both input paths share; MP01@P4 (b b~ > e- e+) and MP02@P6 (b b~ > t t~) fail the same way (tmp/ms-validate/mp1)
findings.status: fixed on work/v2-ms-validate (19619e62: scalar_frontend decides a conditional whose test reads only exact numbers at lowering and lowers only its taken branch, as Python evaluates it; undecided tests stay native run-time conditionals; unit test test_fixed_condition_lowers_only_the_taken_branch): SC08 82/82, ST03 134/134, MP01@P4 and MP02@P6 pass (tmp/ms-validate/f4)
findings.routed: MS-VALIDATE (fixed in the package; reviewable as its own commit)

findings.title: The gluon (photon) Ward identity of the EW virtual fails where an external coloured (charged) particle has an absorptive self-energy at its mass
findings.checks: ward: TT03 and TV07 double-double 3e-4 / 6e-5 of the scale (c = 1 and i, every gluon), VV05 photon c = i 4e-4; rule 1 = MadLoop at the physical polarisations
findings.evidence: probe-ward (TT03, double-double, leg 1): residual 3.3e-4 (c = 1), 5.2e-5 (c = i) of the scale at the card (t -> b W open), 5e-30 and 4e-29 at MW = 180, MZ = 200 (stable top), the bare, R2 and UV parts 1e-2 each: the real on-shell counterterms (Re Sigma) leave the external top's absorptive part unrenormalised, the scheme's property, not an engine defect (the identity holds under CMS); under CMS with Gamma_t = 0 (CM07, native inputs, tmp/ms-validate/cm4) the gluon Ward diagnostic misses by 1.2e-3 of the scale (the external top on its real line mass keeps t -> b W absorptive), while CM05 (no external top) holds at 4e-31: the same mechanism; CM07's acceptance checks all pass (86/86, rule 1 = MadLoop CMS 6.9e-13)
findings.status: resolved in the manifest: TT03 and TV07 check Ward at a stable top (ward_parameters MW = 180, MZ = 200); VV05 (external W) and ST03 (external top and W) defer it to the CMS rows (CM05, CM07, CM09)
